question: Does source-family-level confirmation accounting improve calibration and reduce overconfidence versus counting correlated Sporttery pools as independent confirmations?
hypothesis: Collapsing HAD/HHAD/TTG/CRS/HAFU into one Sporttery source family for independence counting will reduce confidence inflation while preserving structural-consistency diagnostics.
comparison_arms: A: raw confirmation count by pool
B: source-family confirmation count with structural-consistency labels

reject_or_keep_shadow_if: Source-family accounting does not reduce overconfidence or high-confidence misses.
Calibration worsens materially without compensating decision-quality benefit.
The provenance grouping cannot be reproduced from raw source metadata.
External context reports are incorrectly treated as reproducible multi-book price confirmation.
